title: Reset a forgotten password
text: On the sign-in page, choose Forgot password. Enter your account email and open the reset link we send you. The link expires after 30 minutes. Request a new link if the old one expires.

title: Change a known password
text: When you can already sign in, open Settings, then Security, then Change password. Enter your current password and a new password. This action signs out other active sessions.

title: Recover access without an authenticator
text: If you lose the phone used for two-factor authentication, sign in with one of your saved recovery codes. Each code works once. If you have no recovery codes, contact support to start identity verification.

title: Change your email address
text: Open Settings, then Profile, to update your account email. Confirm the verification message sent to the new address. Your old address remains active until verification succeeds.

title: Invite a teammate
text: An administrator can open Members and select Invite. Enter the teammate's email address and choose a role. Invitations expire after seven days; an administrator can resend an expired invitation.

title: Remove a teammate
text: An administrator can remove a member from the Members page. Removal revokes workspace access immediately. Documents created by the removed member remain in the workspace and can be reassigned.

title: Transfer workspace ownership
text: The current owner can transfer ownership to an existing administrator under Workspace settings. The new owner must accept the transfer email. Every workspace must retain one owner.

title: Download a billing invoice
text: Open Billing, then Invoice history. Select a billing month and download its PDF invoice. Only owners and billing administrators can access invoice history.

title: Replace a payment card
text: Open Billing, then Payment method, to add a new card. Set the new card as the default before removing the old card. A failed payment can be retried after the card is updated.

title: Cancel a paid subscription
text: The workspace owner can cancel renewal from Billing, then Manage plan. Paid features remain available until the current billing period ends. Canceling renewal does not delete the account or workspace documents.

title: Permanently delete an account
text: Open Settings, then Privacy, then Delete account. Confirm deletion by typing the account email. Account deletion permanently removes personal data after a seven-day recovery period. Transfer workspace ownership before deleting an owner account.

title: Request a refund
text: Contact billing support within 14 days of the first paid subscription charge to request a refund review. Include the invoice number. Renewal charges are not covered by this first-purchase refund policy.

title: Export workspace records
text: An owner can open Workspace settings, then Export, to download records as a ZIP containing CSV files. An email arrives when the export is ready. The download link expires after 24 hours.

title: Import records from CSV
text: Choose Import on the Records page and upload a UTF-8 CSV file. The first row must contain column names. Map the source columns before confirming the import; duplicate record IDs are rejected.

title: Restore a deleted document
text: Deleted documents stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the document, and choose Restore. Documents permanently removed from Trash cannot be recovered through the app.

title: Create a public sharing link
text: Open a document's Share menu and enable Public link. Anyone with this link can view the document without signing in. Public links grant read-only access and do not allow editing.

title: Disable a public sharing link
text: Open the document's Share menu and turn off Public link. Previously copied links stop granting access immediately. Workspace members who already have permission can still view the document.

title: Create an API token
text: Open Settings, then Developer, then API tokens. Choose the smallest required permissions and create a token. Copy the value when displayed; it cannot be shown again. Revoke unused tokens from the same page.

title: Handle API rate limits
text: The API allows 60 requests per minute per token. Requests over the limit return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Wait for the specified interval before sending another request.

title: Understand webhook delivery retries
text: Webhook endpoints must return a successful response within five seconds. Failed deliveries are retried after one minute, five minutes, and 30 minutes. Use the event ID to prevent processing duplicate deliveries.

title: Reconnect an expired integration
text: If a connected service reports expired credentials, open Integrations and choose Reconnect. Sign in to the external service again and approve the required access. Existing synchronization settings are preserved.

title: Mute email notifications
text: Open Settings, then Notifications, to turn off activity summary emails. Security alerts and billing notices remain enabled. You can separately mute notifications for one document from its Follow menu.

title: Interpret billing timestamps
text: Invoice timestamps and billing period boundaries use UTC. Changing your profile's display time zone does not change billing dates. Usage reports show the time zone beside each timestamp.

title: Support ticket attachment size
text: Each support-ticket attachment can be at most 20 MB. Supported formats are PNG, JPEG, PDF, and plain text. Split a larger file into smaller attachments or describe the issue without an attachment. Never attach passwords or API tokens.
